verdicts.reason: The summary places anarchism's golden age across the whole 1880-1916 conservative period ("entre 1880 y 1916, el anarquismo experimentó su propia 'Edad de Oro'") instead of the early 1900s after FORA's 1901 founding.
The summary never mentions the golden-age claim being an oligarchic narrative the video rejects, nor the argument that exclusion made workers receptive to anarchism.
The summary gives no figures on the growth in the number of unions.
It mentions government repression led by Falcon and the Semana Roja ("la represión gubernamental... Semana Roja"), the state's repressive response, though it omits the specific laws.
It says FORA pursued integral cultural development through La Protesta, Ideas y Figuras, popular education and various media and activities.
